meaning.en: A farewell wish: have a smooth journey.
meaning.zh: 送别时祝愿旅途平安顺利。

examples.zh: 祝你一路顺风，到了来个电话。
examples.en: Have a good trip, and call me when you arrive.

examples.zh: 临行前大家齐声说：“一路顺风！”
examples.en: As he left, everyone called out together, 'Bon voyage!'

usage.en: A set farewell; often a stand-alone wish.
usage.zh: 送别套话，常单独使用。

meaning.en: Of tremendous force that nothing can resist.
meaning.zh: 形容威力极大，不可抵挡。

examples.zh: 警方以雷霆万钧之势摧毁了这个团伙。
examples.en: The police crushed the gang with overwhelming force.

examples.zh: 洪水以雷霆万钧之势冲下山谷。
examples.en: The flood thundered down the valley with irresistible force.

usage.zh: 常说“以雷霆万钧之势”。

natural: for the nation and its people

meaning.en: Acting for the good of the country and its people.
meaning.zh: 为国家、为百姓着想和做事。

equivalents: serve the nation and the people

examples.zh: 他一生为国为民，两袖清风。
examples.en: All his life he served the country and its people, with clean hands.

examples.zh: 官员应当为国为民，而不是谋私利。
examples.en: Officials should serve the nation and its people, not private interest.

usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语，含赞扬。

meaning.en: To pretend to refuse while actually being willing.
meaning.zh: 嘴上推辞，心里却愿意，指一边推托一边答应。

examples.zh: 大家劝他当班长，他半推半就地答应了。
examples.en: Everyone urged him to be monitor and he half-heartedly accepted.

examples.zh: 她半推半就收下了礼物。
examples.en: She made a show of refusing and then took the gift.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。

meaning.en: To suddenly understand something that was previously unclear.
meaning.zh: 原来心里像被茅草堵住，一下子打开了，形容忽然领悟。

examples.zh: 听了老师的讲解，我茅塞顿开。
examples.en: After the teacher's explanation, it all suddenly became clear.

examples.zh: 你这一句话让我茅塞顿开。
examples.en: That one remark made everything click.

story.en: Mencius: a mountain path used often becomes a road, but unused it is 'blocked by thatch' (为间不用，则茅塞之矣), a figure for a mind closed up.
story.zh: 《孟子》：“山径之蹊间，介然用之而成路；为间不用，则茅塞之矣。”

usage.en: Predicate; often after 听君一席话.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“听君一席话，茅塞顿开”。

meaning.en: To mislead people with false and seductive talk.
meaning.zh: 用谎言或花言巧语迷惑和煽动人心。

equivalents: stir up the masses with lies

examples.zh: 他靠散布谣言蛊惑人心。
examples.en: He swayed people by spreading rumours.

examples.zh: 网络上有人蛊惑人心，大家要提高警惕。
examples.en: Some online try to mislead the public; everyone should stay vigilant.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，含贬义。

literal: think of · this · lie in · this

meaning.en: To keep thinking of one thing and never let it go.
meaning.zh: 心里始终想着某一件事。

examples.zh: 他对教育事业念兹在兹。
examples.en: He is constantly devoted to education.

examples.zh: 这件事她念兹在兹，从未放弃。
examples.en: She has kept this matter in mind and never given up.

story.en: Gao Yao on assessing a man's virtue: 'Think of this, and it is in this; cast it aside and it is still in this' (念兹在兹，释兹在兹).
story.zh: 《尚书·大禹谟》：“念兹在兹，释兹在兹，名言兹在兹，允出兹在兹。”

date.zh: 东晋 · 约4世纪初（伪古文《尚书》篇章）
date.en: Eastern Jin, early 4th c. (spurious “Old Text” chapter of the Book of Documents)

usage.zh: 多作谓语，较正式，常见于讲话。

meaning.en: To walk with head high and look proud and arrogant.
meaning.zh: 走路脚抬得很高，神气十足，形容骄傲自满、得意忘形。

examples.zh: 他当上经理后，整天趾高气扬。
examples.en: Since becoming manager he has strutted about all day.

examples.zh: 对方趾高气扬地走进会场。
examples.en: The other side swaggered into the hall.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，含贬义。

meaning.en: To obtain something and then lose it again.
meaning.zh: 好不容易得到又失去了。

equivalents: lose it again just after winning it

examples.zh: 好不容易拿到的订单得而复失，大家很沮丧。
examples.en: The hard-won order slipped away again, and everyone was dispirited.

examples.zh: 冠军得而复失，球迷十分惋惜。
examples.en: The title was won only to be lost, to the fans' regret.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To raise a past matter again.
meaning.zh: 把过去的事情再拿出来说。

examples.zh: 都过去这么久了，别再旧事重提了。
examples.en: It's been so long, so don't bring it up again.

examples.zh: 他在会上旧事重提，气氛一下子尴尬起来。
examples.en: He brought up the old affair at the meeting, and the mood turned awkward.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“别”“不要”连用。

natural: no scope to show one's skill

meaning.en: To have no opportunity to use one's abilities.
meaning.zh: 没有施展本领的机会或场所。

equivalents: no scope to use one's talents
be left with nothing to do

examples.zh: 这里没有人需要他的专长，他简直无用武之地。
examples.en: Nobody here needs his expertise; he has no scope for it.

examples.zh: 在偏僻小镇，我这点技术无用武之地。
examples.en: In a remote town my skills find no use.

usage.en: Predicate or object; often 英雄无用武之地.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常说“英雄无用武之地”。

meaning.en: Of an evil influence or person that keeps lingering and will not go away.
meaning.zh: 鬼魂不肯离去，比喻坏人或坏影响依然存在，缠着不放。

examples.zh: 那个债主阴魂不散，天天来堵门。
examples.en: That creditor hounds me every day like a ghost.

examples.zh: 旧习气阴魂不散，改起来很难。
examples.en: The old bad habits linger like ghosts and are hard to shake.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，形象，常带无奈。

natural: pull the main line and the mesh opens

meaning.en: When the main point is grasped, the details fall into place.
meaning.zh: 提起渔网的总绳，网眼就都张开了，比喻抓住主要环节，其余问题就迎刃而解。

equivalents: grasp the key and the rest follows

examples.zh: 管理要抓住关键，才能纲举目张。
examples.en: Management must seize the key points so the rest falls into place.

examples.zh: 文章结构清晰，纲举目张。
examples.en: The essay has a clear structure in which everything follows from the main points.

story.en: The text says that pulling the main rope of a net opens its thousand meshes: 'Draw up the main rope and the countless meshes all open' (壹引其纲，万目皆张).
story.zh: 《吕氏春秋》：“若鼓之有桴，若网之有纲，壹引其纲，万目皆张。”

usage.en: Predicate; often 才能纲举目张.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“才能纲举目张”。

meaning.en: Lacking vitality; dull and listless.
meaning.zh: 气氛沉闷，缺乏生气和活力。

examples.zh: 这个部门死气沉沉，没人愿意创新。
examples.en: This department is lifeless and nobody wants to innovate.

examples.zh: 考试周的校园死气沉沉。
examples.en: The campus in exam week was dreary and quiet.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To find the conversation uncongenial because views differ.
meaning.zh: 说话彼此意见不合，谈不到一块儿。

examples.zh: 两人话不投机，不欢而散。
examples.en: The two talked at cross purposes and parted unhappily.

examples.zh: 话不投机半句多，他起身走了。
examples.en: Where talk doesn't click even half a sentence is too many; he got up and left.

usage.en: Predicate; often 话不投机半句多.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“话不投机半句多”。

meaning.en: Mist-covered water stretching far into the distance.
meaning.zh: 水面辽阔，烟雾弥漫，一眼望不到边。

examples.zh: 洞庭湖烟波浩渺，景色迷人。
examples.en: Lake Dongting is a vast misty expanse, enchanting to see.

examples.zh: 远处烟波浩渺，不见对岸。
examples.en: In the distance the misty waters stretch on, the far shore invisible.

usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，用于写景。

meaning.en: Out of ammunition and supplies; in utter desperation.
meaning.zh: 子弹打完了，粮食也断了，形容处境极端困难。

equivalents: at the end of one's resources

examples.zh: 守军弹尽粮绝，只好投降。
examples.en: The garrison, out of ammunition and food, had to surrender.

examples.zh: 探险队弹尽粮绝，等待救援。
examples.en: The expedition ran out of supplies and awaited rescue.

usage.en: Predicate; a variant is 弹尽援绝.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也作“弹尽援绝”。

natural: give up the pen for the sword

meaning.en: To abandon a scholar's life and join the army.
meaning.zh: 扔下笔去参军，指文人从军。

equivalents: trade the pen for the sword
give up scholarship for the army

examples.zh: 抗战爆发后，不少学生投笔从戎。
examples.en: When war broke out, many students left their books to join up.

examples.zh: 他放弃了教职，投笔从戎。
examples.en: He gave up teaching to take up arms.

story.en: Ban Chao, a copyist, threw down his brush, sighing that a man should win merit in far lands like Zhang Qian and not serve long among pens and inkstones.
story.zh: 《后汉书》：“大丈夫无他志略，犹当效傅介子、张骞立功异域，以取封侯，安能久事笔研间乎？”

usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语。

antonyms: 好铁不打钉，好男不当兵

meaning.en: To solve a tangled problem decisively and quickly.
meaning.zh: 用快刀砍断乱麻，比喻做事果断利落，迅速解决复杂问题。

examples.zh: 遇到纠纷，他总能快刀斩乱麻地解决。
examples.en: Faced with disputes, he always settles them decisively.

examples.zh: 这件事必须快刀斩乱麻，不能拖。
examples.en: This must be dealt with decisively; no more delay.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate; often 要/需要.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。

story.en: The Book of Northern Qi tells how Gao Huan tested his sons by giving each a tangle of silk to sort; Gao Yang drew his sword and cut it through, saying 'a tangle must be cut' (乱者须斩). The decisive act became 快刀斩乱麻.
story.zh: 《北齐书·文宣帝纪》载：高欢令诸子各治乱丝，高洋独抽刀斩之，曰“乱者须斩”。后作“快刀斩乱麻”。

natural: the stars wheel and the seasons pass

meaning.en: The Big Dipper turns and the stars shift: time passes and things change.
meaning.zh: 北斗转向，星辰移位，指季节变换，时间流逝。

examples.zh: 斗转星移，二十年一晃就过去了。
examples.en: The stars wheeled by and twenty years flashed past.

examples.zh: 斗转星移，老街早已变了模样。
examples.en: Time has passed and the old street has changed beyond recognition.

usage.zh: 常放句首，书面语。

meaning.en: Heroic emotions and grand ambitions.
meaning.zh: 豪迈的感情和远大的志向。

examples.zh: 他满怀豪情壮志，要闯出一番事业。
examples.en: Full of bold ambition, he meant to build a career.

examples.zh: 年轻人的豪情壮志令人感动。
examples.en: The young people's lofty ideals are moving.

usage.en: Noun; often 满怀/抒发豪情壮志.
usage.zh: 名词，常说“满怀豪情壮志”。

meaning.en: Fussy, long-winded and indecisive, like an old woman.
meaning.zh: 形容言语啰嗦，行为琐碎，做事不果断。

examples.zh: 你别婆婆妈妈的，痛快点！
examples.en: Stop dithering and be decisive!

examples.zh: 他做事婆婆妈妈，总是下不了决心。
examples.en: He is fussy and never makes up his mind.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; colloquial and a bit gendered.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，口语，带性别刻板色彩。

pinyin: yī shī zú chéng qiān gǔ hèn
literal: one · slip · become · thousand · ages · regret

meaning.en: A single serious mistake can cause regret for a lifetime.
meaning.zh: 一次严重的失误会造成终身的悔恨。

equivalents: one false step brings lasting regret
a moment's error, a lifetime of regret

examples.zh: 一失足成千古恨，千万别走上歪路。
examples.en: One slip can mean a lifetime of regret, so don't take the wrong path.

examples.zh: 他酒后驾车出了事，真是一失足成千古恨。
examples.en: He crashed after drinking and driving, a moment's slip he will regret for life.

usage.zh: 俗语，常用于告诫。

meaning.en: Each person contributes all they are able to.
meaning.zh: 每个人都尽自己的力量。

examples.zh: 志愿者们各尽所能，帮助灾区重建。
examples.en: The volunteers each did their utmost to help rebuild the disaster area.

examples.zh: 大家各尽所能，把晚会办得很成功。
examples.en: Everyone pitched in and made the party a success.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 各取所需 or 按劳分配.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“各取所需”连用。
